results.title: Read this if you're new to game jams - Community - GDevelop Forum
results.snippet: I recently posted a “guide” to help game jam newbies out. So if this is your first game jam, but you don’t know how to get started, then maybe the post will help you out a bit. I should also mention that I go over some really basic stuff on what to do, like “following the game jam rules”. ...
